symptom: Upper Structure Does Not Swing in Two Directions of Right and Left
detail_of_failure: The upper structure does not swing right or left.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • F pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01100) • R pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01101)

steps.procedure: 1. Take measurements. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine PPC Valve Outlet Pressure”. 2. Does the measurement result agree with the standard value? steps.cause: The parking brake of swing motor
steps.procedure: 1. Do the swing operation while the swing motor brake is released to do the troubleshooting. 2. Does it operate without a relief during a swing operation?

branches.YES: • The parking brake of swing motor is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The parking brake of swing motor is defective. • Replace the parking brake of swing motor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Open the Front Pump Pressure screen. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “How to Examine Monitoring Information” of “Service Mode”. 2. Start the engine. 3. Do swing operation with the work equipment lever to do the troubleshooting. 4. Does the measurement result agree with the standard value? Measurement position, condi- Standard val- Item tion ue Front Approximately pump 4 MPa {ap- Monitoring code: 01100 presproximately sure 41 kgf/cm2}

branches.YES: Go to the check item of “Swing control valve”.
branches.NO: Go to the check item of “Safety valve of swing motor”.

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping to do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Examine the control valve body and the swing spool to see if they are not twisted or stuck and that they do not have any damage or dirt on them. (They must move smoothly and not be stuck.) REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

branches.YES: • The swing control valve body and spool are correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The swing control valve body and spool are defective. • Replace the body and spool of the swing control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine and Adjust Oil Pressure in Work Equipment, Swing, and Travel Circuits”. 2. steps.procedure: Is the swing machinery clean, with no unusual noise, abnormal heat, or metal powder in the drain oil?

branches.YES: • The swing machinery is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The swing machinery is defective. • Replace the swing machinery. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine to do the troubleshooting. 4. Does the machine swing normally?

branches.NO: Return to the first check item.
